Use case: illustration-story. ONE NEW finished 1024x1536 portrait comic page, header «Capítulo 7 · 17». Seven sequential scenes, warm expressive cartoon ink-and-paint, cream gutters and black frames, large legible accented Spanish text. Fantasy SCHOOL PROJECT about ENCHANTED CLOTH TOY DOLLS. This is the calm conclusion of the initial magical simulation and preparation to receive the toy.
Reference1 supplies Elsie Tanner's face and BLUE-CURTAINED BOTANICAL OFFICE. ELSIE elderly woman, GRAY WAVY HAIR in LOW BUN, OVAL GLASSES, NAVY HIGH-NECK LONG-SLEEVED ROBE and silver EAGLE pendant with BLUE SAPPHIRE, kind adult face. Reference2 supplies current office layout with cot hidden by WHITE CLOSED CURTAIN, wooden desk, golden lamp, botanical drawings. Reference3 supplies HERMIONE and PANSY faces/uniforms only. HERMIONE enormous BROWN CURLS/freckles/WARM BROWN irises/BURGUNDY-GOLD tie. PANSY straight BLACK chin bob/GREEN irises/GREEN-SILVER tie. Both WHITE SHIRT, GRAY SWEATER and LONG BLACK SCHOOL ROBES. Separate chairs at desk for ordinary conversation.
1. Elsie smiles to the two students: «¿Cómo se sienten? ¿Quieren preguntarme algo antes de conocerlo?» Cot in corner, WHITE CURTAIN CLOSED.
2. PANSY LEFT looks towards closed curtain, asks «¿Ya está ahí?» ELSIE RIGHT replies «Sí. Está dormido. Pero quizá se despierte cuando se acerquen.» Correct short tails.
3. Elsie hands Hermione a small AMBER fantasy-potion flask, ordinary desk-level view, fully dressed. Elsie says «Primero vamos a poner fin a la simulación.» Hermione accepts the flask. Magic school prop only, no printed label. Show bottle handover, not a drinking close-up.
4. Normal face portrait of Hermione relaxing, BROWN eyes, soft relieved smile. Cream narration: «La recorrió una sensación cálida y reconfortante. Poco a poco se sintió más ligera.» No other visual change.
5. Three small separated dialogue portraits in left-to-right order: PANSY «¿Cómo te sientes?» HERMIONE «Diferente. Es una sensación extraña.» ELSIE «Los efectos de la simulación han terminado. Puede que aún necesites descansar.» Preserve correct identities and irises.
6. Cot curtain remains closed, a small rustle under the unseen toy's folded cover. ELSIE at cot says «Creo que alguien está listo para conocerlas.» Separate small PANSY reaction inset, balloon «¿Listo?»
7. Elsie draws curtain slightly aside and says «Pueden acercarse.» Carefully crop above the cot edge so ONLY a tiny CLOTH TOY HAND with opaque CREAM sleeve peeks over folded CREAM blanket. Toy FACE stays completely OUT OF FRAME until next page. No face reveal here.
Only quoted Spanish text and header, correct tails, consistent blue/gold office and high-neck uniforms. No extra dialogue or end caption.
